common.manifestNoScript: Error: Manifest does not contain script
common.newVersion: A new version of this site is available
common.unsupportedFileType: That file type can't be opened
common.couldNotRestorePosition: Could not restore your last reading position
common.extensionMessage: Get the InfoGata extension for enhanced plugin functionality
common.publicationNotFound: This publication could not be found
common.appCrashDescription: Something went wrong before the app finished loading. Trying again is usually enough; if it keeps happening, resetting removes the stored data that's most likely causing it.
common.resetAppDataConfirm: This removes your installed plugins, saved logins, library, reading positions, bookmarks and settings, then reloads. It can't be undone.

plugins.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this plugin?
plugins.confirmUpdatePlugin: This plugin is already installed. Would you like to update it?
plugins.installPluginFromUrl: Install plugin using a link to a plugin's manifest.json
plugins.manifestMissingFromUrl: The filename 'manifest.json' must be in the url
plugins.urlAliasDescription: Used in this plugin's urls, e.g. /s/{{alias}}/feed
plugins.aliasErrorInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only
plugins.aliasErrorIsPluginId: Already used as a plugin id

settings.analyticsDescription: Cookieless usage data that shows which parts of the app get used and what breaks. Nothing that identifies you.
settings.analyticsDoNotTrack: Your browser sends Do Not Track, so nothing is collected regardless of this setting.
settings.chatDescription: A chat assistant that can find and open books for you, using your plugins and the web. Bring your own AI provider key. Keys are stored only on this device and requests go straight from here to the provider.
settings.chatBaseUrlHint: OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 · Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 (start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS set to this site) · LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1
settings.chatSearchNative: Nothing else is needed. If requests fail with a quota error, your plan may not include search (Gemini's free tier doesn't for Gemini 3): turn this off and use a search key instead.
settings.chatSearchFallback: Without the provider's own search, add a search API key to let the assistant look beyond your plugins.

library.emptyDescription: Books and PDFs you open show up here, along with your reading position and bookmarks.
library.browsePlugins: Add a plugin to browse catalogs
library.locateFileHint: This was opened from your device, so only the reading position was saved. Choose the file again to continue reading.
library.confirmRemoveDescription: This deletes the saved reading position and bookmarks for "{{title}}". The file itself is not deleted.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.intro: Ask for a book and I'll search your plugins and the web, then open it.
chat.introPluginsOnly: Ask for a book and I'll search your plugins, then open it. Add a web search provider in Settings to search the web too.
chat.noProvider: Choose an AI provider and enter its API key in Settings.
chat.noApiKey: Enter an API key for your AI provider in Settings.
chat.noBaseUrl: Enter the base URL of your OpenAI-compatible server in Settings.
chat.noModel: Enter a model id in Settings.
chat.errorAuth: {{provider}} rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
chat.errorRateLimit: {{provider}} refused the request because of a rate limit or a used-up quota. Try again in a moment, or check your plan with the provider.
chat.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your connection, and for a local server, that it allows requests from this site.
chat.errorNoTools: This model doesn't support tool calling, which the assistant needs. Choose another model in Settings.
